description:
The main character, Jeong Chan-ho, who had a unique desire for money and pride since childhood. When he got tired of working as a professional golf instructor, he met with a customer who was extremely generous, Mr. Park. “Actually… it’s my fake.” “Do you make a lot of money if you do that?” The secret of Park’s wealth is ‘fake’?! After hearing that fake money can make a lot of money, Chan-ho jumps into the world of fake money by learning about it from Park….

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Naver Webtoon](https://comic.naver.com/webtoon/list.nhn?titleId=830010), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=11608933)
